iqvia_bullets.text: Led **0-to-1 development** of an internal doctor-chemist mapping product powering client go-to-market territory planning; owned problem definition and requirements, scoped a 1-month MVP, and delivered **~50% higher mapping accuracy**.

Prototyped an internal natural-language querying tool integrating LLM APIs over large unstructured Excel datasets, enabling non-technical stakeholders to extract analytical insights on demand; **adopted by 100+ users**.

Reduced competitive-intelligence research time by **85%** for a **40-member consulting team** by engineering an automated Generative AI workflow that extracts, filters, and summarizes strategic updates from pharma news feeds.

Designed a Brand Health Tracking dashboard in Power BI monitoring **10+ commercial KPIs**, integrating quantitative sales data with qualitative physician surveys so stakeholders could diagnose the root causes behind prescription and sales trends.

Executed a Healthcare Professional (HCP) targeting and segmentation exercise across **30+ cities** using product adoption KPIs and prescriber potential, generating **Rs. 15 Cr+ incremental revenue** within 8 months and reallocating commercial coverage.

Improved market penetration by **15%** for a top Indian pharma client by owning a chemist segmentation and targeting engagement across 4 therapy areas in 5 cities, identifying high-potential outlets and coverage gaps to redirect field resources.

Crafted lifecycle management strategy, leading to **~35% revenue protection**, for a flagship **Rs. 500 Cr franchise** facing Loss of Exclusivity (LoE); integrated pricing analysis, revenue forecasting and competitive GTM benchmarking for defense strategy.

Contributed to a product portfolio expansion strategy, unlocking **Rs. 100+ Cr in incremental revenues** for a pharma client; designed a prioritization framework to shortlist 5 acquisition-ready brands based on segment growth and company synergy.

Identified and projected a **$50M revenue opportunity** over 5 years for a global blockbuster biologic's India market entry by mapping end-to-end patient treatment journey, sizing the addressable market and building a comprehensive growth model.

Facilitated market entry into **10+ high-growth segments** valued at **Rs. 2k+ Cr** by conducting a comprehensive market landscape of the Rs. 17k Cr Indian derma-cosmeceuticals sector, identifying underserved whitespace opportunities for portfolio augmentation.

Developed a 5-year strategic revenue forecast for an oncology portfolio, projecting **$22M in peak sales**; integrated epidemiology trends and competitive risks to support commercialization strategy, investment planning and cross-functional team sizing.

bain_bullets.text: Refined product positioning and value proposition for a **$20B enterprise storage client** from 10+ customer survey insights.
Shaped GTM and product positioning for the client's **AI Studio platform** using survey analytics across **300+ C-suite respondents**.
Segmented an IT firm's user base into **behavioral personas** that informed targeted product strategy and roadmap priorities.
Benchmarked **20+ AI/ML, GPUaaS, CSPs companies** across 5+ valuation parameters to guide investment assessments for a PE client.
Designed an automated internal workflow system, streamlining cross-functional execution and **improving efficiency by ~25%**.

jll_bullets.text: Partnered with product, engineering, and QA stakeholders to translate business requirements into **80+ validated user stories**, defining acceptance criteria and an executable test strategy across 4+ UAT cycles ahead of release.

Designed and executed **100+ use-case scenarios** across core product workflows, covering **30% of the product's business requirements** and surfacing gaps between written specification and shipped behavior.

Owned 50% of QA scope, converting user feedback and business requirements into **70+ logged defects** prioritized by release risk; automated 40% of legacy workflows, cutting **manual testing effort by 50%**.

projects.title: Uber India - Product Improvement Case Study
projects.text: Uber India - Product Improvement Case Study: Designed a pre-booking route selection feature addressing commuter price shock from opaque route/toll defaults; authored **complete PRD**, competitive benchmarking, and driver navigation handoff specifications and built a user interactive prototype demonstrating **dual-corridor (fastest vs cheapest)** fare switching.

projects.title: CDSCO Intel - Conversational Regulatory Intelligence Platform
projects.text: CDSCO Intel - Conversational Regulatory Intelligence Platform: Built a 0-to-1 platform indexing **5,139 official Indian drug clearances** to replace manual SUGAM portal lookups, cutting **research time by ~90%**; architected a hybrid Gemini Text-to-SQL engine with 7 grounding rules, achieving **<58ms median latency** and **100% zero-hallucination accuracy** across 24 therapy areas; shipped one-click Excel/PPT exports with an embedded executive telemetry dashboard.

projects.text: Smart Speaker Prototype: Conceptualized a smart speaker solution; conducted user research, feature prioritization, and usability testing to validate design decisions and refine the product roadmap for various daily tasks automation.
